detected_document_type.description: What this document actually is, whatever it was declared as.

readable.description: False if the page or document can't be read reliably.

unreadable_reason.description: Why it can't be read (blur, glare, cropped, too dark ...), or null.

year_end.description: Financial year end. Date as YYYY-MM-DD.

units.description: How amounts are shown, e.g. KES or KES '000.

revenue.description: Amount as a plain number with 2 decimals, no commas or currency; negative with a leading minus, e.g. -1250.00.

cost_of_sales.description: Amount as a plain number with 2 decimals, no commas or currency; negative with a leading minus, e.g. -1250.00.

operating_profit.description: Amount as a plain number with 2 decimals, no commas or currency; negative with a leading minus, e.g. -1250.00.

finance_costs.description: Amount as a plain number with 2 decimals, no commas or currency; negative with a leading minus, e.g. -1250.00.

net_profit.description: Profit after tax (negative for a loss). Amount as a plain number with 2 decimals, no commas or currency; negative with a leading minus, e.g. -1250.00.

total_assets.description: Amount as a plain number with 2 decimals, no commas or currency; negative with a leading minus, e.g. -1250.00.

current_assets.description: Amount as a plain number with 2 decimals, no commas or currency; negative with a leading minus, e.g. -1250.00.

current_liabilities.description: Amount as a plain number with 2 decimals, no commas or currency; negative with a leading minus, e.g. -1250.00.

total_liabilities.description: Amount as a plain number with 2 decimals, no commas or currency; negative with a leading minus, e.g. -1250.00.

equity.description: Amount as a plain number with 2 decimals, no commas or currency; negative with a leading minus, e.g. -1250.00.

cash.description: Cash and cash equivalents. Amount as a plain number with 2 decimals, no commas or currency; negative with a leading minus, e.g. -1250.00.

value.description: Exactly what is printed (normalised as described), or null if it is absent or can't be read.

confidence.description: 0 to 1: how sure you are the value is read correctly.

source_text.description: Up to 80 characters copied from around the value.

notes.description: Anything the reviewer should know, or null.
